theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν₁ ν₂ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν₁ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν₂ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∫ x, f x ∂ν₁ = ∫ x, f x ∂ν₂) → ν₁ = ν₂
